original_test_intent: Verify the BMC KVM video and remote input path functions with the defined USB hub absent, so the no-hub topology is independently proven not to prevent correct console display, responsiveness and bounded input delivery.
original_method: Select by row/variant; identify BMC/SUT/firmware/browser/KVM client and diagram the no-hub video and HID paths; photograph or inventory the absent hub/connection state; authorized operator launches a fresh web KVM session, verifies the correct host/boot screen, observes stability and latency, performs one harmless non-destructive keyboard/mouse action on a safe screen, records video/session evidence, then closes the session and preserves BMC/host events without touching power, reset or virtual media.
manual_activity: An authorized operator proves the no-hub topology, operates the web KVM and directly observes video plus one approved harmless input action.
required_inputs: Unique identity resolution for the duplicate code
BMC/SUT/firmware/browser/KVM-client identity and supported security/TLS/session configuration
Authoritative no-USB-hub video/HID topology and proof method
Expected display/latency/stability/reconnect behavior and bounded harmless keyboard/mouse input matrix on a safe screen
safety_requirements: Select by row/variant and verify the exact BMC/SUT before login
Protect credentials/session artifacts and prohibit power/reset/virtual-media controls
Prove hub absence independently rather than inferring it from KVM behavior
Use only a harmless input on a non-destructive screen; do not type into shell, firmware update or active workload contexts
Stop on wrong host, blank/frozen/stale display, unexpected input target, excessive latency, BMC fault or instability; no automatic relaunch
agent_execution_scope: Validate composite identity, topology, client/security prerequisites and safe input plan
Organize operator screenshots/video, session timings and BMC event evidence
Compare supplied display/input observations to approved criteria without claiming sight
Do not log in/operate KVM, inject input, issue power/reset/media, clear logs, reuse GB sensor evidence or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve duplicate-code ownership while preserving both rows
Approve no-hub topology, client, display/input/stability criteria and safe screen/action
Review session evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: MEDIUM MANUAL BMC KVM NO_USB_HUB VIDEO_AND_INPUT_VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Document the no-hub signal/HID topology and execute a bounded visual/input matrix on a safe screen with session evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds collision-safe identity, path proof, correct-host/video/stability/latency/input oracle and control prohibitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: BMC reachability, GB sensor status or session launch alone cannot prove KVM video/input functionality or hub absence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Remote input can alter the DUT if focus is wrong; visual responsiveness is operator-observed and network latency must be distinguished from KVM failure.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must define which hub is intentionally absent and whether video and HID normally traverse different paths. The case must remain distinct from the completed with-hub baseline row 2206.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and separation from row 2039 GB status
Diagram plus photo/inventory proving the specified USB hub is absent
Timestamped screenshots/video of correct host display, stability and approved harmless input response
Session launch/close, latency/reconnect observations and preserved BMC/SEL/host events

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Wistron-BMC-01058-V002 identifies both row 2039 Check Status - GB and row 2205 KVM - Without USB hub. Row/variant makes this review reliable, but code-only selection could substitute unrelated sensor collection for the manual KVM test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The no-hub KVM objective is clear. Exact topology, client, harmless input and acceptance rubric are supplyable prerequisites.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2205 Wistron-BMC-01058-V002: assign/approve a unique identity distinct from row 2039 GB Status; define the exact USB hub that must be absent and video/HID topology, BMC/SUT/firmware/browser/KVM client, TLS/session prerequisites, correct-display/stability/latency/reconnect criteria, bounded harmless keyboard/mouse input matrix and safe screen, credential/session handling, stop conditions and recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents GB-sensor cross-dispatch and gives normal KVM a bounded, evidence-based no-hub video/input definition without unsafe control actions.
independent_technical_reasoning: KVM launch is only session establishment; it does not prove correct, live video or delivered input. The no-hub condition is the differentiator and must be evidenced at the physical/logical path rather than inferred. One controlled input is needed to cover KVM function but must occur on a safe screen to avoid changing DUT state. The shared code with GB status makes composite identity mandatory before any human or automated action.
